name: osd-lock-ignore
summary: Key handler ignores an already-persisted D6 key-lock bit (heals units that are already locked)
status: verified-by-analysis; equivalent to specpatch 'osd-lock-ignore' (other chat address 0x35577C)
notes: sub_258E5D at 0x258F78: if settings +0x4C bit 4 is set and the key code is < 5, it only sets the active port's re-detect flag (port table 0x3B4950 + n*0xB0, byte +0x1C bit 0) and returns, so the OSD never opens. With the test masked to 0 the branch is never taken. The bit stays in the EEPROM but has no effect; the next 'Processing update' stage clears it.
